title: Idara zimegawanyika vizuri kiasi kwamba inabidi niangalie ni nani wa kumuuliza

text.The departments are split so finely that: Idara zimegawanyika vizuri kiasi kwamba inabidi niangalie ni nani wa kumuuliza
text.Even inside a big company, the departmen: Hata ndani ya kampuni kubwa, idara zimegawanywa vizuri sana.

text.To take sales as an easy example, inside: Ili kuchukua mauzo kama mfano rahisi, ndani yake imegawanywa zaidi, na ambaye kila timu inamtunza.
